nodes.title: Volume of reserve bids
nodes.summary: The data present aggregated bid volumes from market participants submitted for the corresponding Baltic balancing capacity market time unit, product and direction (if applicable) by country. All bids volumes are summed regardless of the bid attributes (exclusive group, technical limitations in maximum duration or minimal resting time or other).

nodes.title: Volume of demand reduction reserve bids
nodes.summary: The data present aggregated bid volumes from Demand reduction resources as defined by market rules, submitted for the corresponding Baltic balancing capacity market time unit, product and direction (if applicable) by country.

nodes.title: Volume of back-up reserve bids
nodes.summary: The data present aggregated bid volumes from Back-up resources as defined by market rules, submitted for the corresponding Baltic balancing capacity market time unit, product and direction (if applicable) by country.

Local marginal price aFRR forming and usage described in TSOs terms and conditions.

 

Price for Latvia area published as weighted average price of aFRR activations done by BSPs in Latvia in MTU per direction. If in one direction there are no activations from BSPs in Latvia, price displayed as single price in both directions in respective MTU. If no activations from BSPs in Latvia than no publication is made for respective MTU.

Aggregated volumes of balancing energy bids based on DA mFRR product.

nodes.title: Normal activations - Local mFRR
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy bids (SA, DA or local) from each Baltic TSO respective BSPs activated locally with balancing purpose.

nodes.title: Special activations - Total mFRR
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy bids (SA, DA or local mFRR) from each Baltic TSO respective BSPs activated locally with purpose countertrade or system services.

nodes.title: DSB (Direction of System Balancing)
nodes.summary: Direction of system balancing indicates the balancing energy reference price (upward vs downward) and the application of neutrality component, for the calculation of the imbalance price. The numerical value “1” shall signify positive balancing direction i.e. the balancing energy reference price shall be the upward balancing energy price of the respective imbalance area, to which the neutrality component shall be added.

nodes.title: Neutrality Component
nodes.summary: Calculated in accordance with each TSOs terms & conditions.

nodes.title: Baltic TSO-TSO exchange
nodes.summary: Baltic exchanged and netted volume in case of Fallback mFRR exchange between Baltic TSO by area.

nodes.title: Total satisfied demand from non-baltic TSO
nodes.summary: Requested and satisfied total demand in MTU from non-Baltic TSO.

nodes.title: Total satisfied demand for balancing purposes mFRR
nodes.summary: Requested and satisfied total demand in MTU. Total demand consists of satisfied demand mFRR for TSOs area BRP imbalance reduction via MARI, locally or from neighboring TSOs.

nodes.title: Netted and exchanged volumes mFRR
nodes.summary: Net position of cross border activation flows resulting from activation in MARI platform, published per Area.

nodes.title: Normal activations - DA mFRR
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy bids from each Baltic TSO respective BSPs activated in DA mFRR activation process.

nodes.title: Normal activations - SA mFRR
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy bids from each Baltic TSO respective BSPs activated in SA mFRR activation process.

nodes.title: Imbalance volumes
nodes.summary: Imbalance volumes depict the hourly area control error value as it would have been be if power balancing was not performed by the TSOs.

nodes.title: Unavailable mFRR bid volumes
nodes.summary:
Unavailable bids refer to aggregated bid volumes, based on mFRR product, which have been adjusted by BSPs prior to or after the balancing bid submission gate closure time. 

Under this item is not included unavailability for MARI activation due to local activation.

nodes.title: Local mFRR (ER) bid volumes
nodes.summary: Aggregated volumes of balancing energy bids based on ER mFRR product, submitted to each Baltic TSO by their local BSPs for upward and downward activation.

nodes.title: SA mFRR bid volumes
nodes.summary:
Aggregated volumes of balancing energy bids based on SA mFRR product, submitted to each Baltic TSO by their local BSPs for upward and downward activation.

Bids, which are eligible for both scheduled and direct activation will be published together with SA bids.

nodes.title: DSB (Direction of System Balancing) (legacy)
nodes.summary: Direction of system balancing indicates the balancing energy reference price (upward vs downward) and the application of neutrality component, for the calculation of the imbalance price. The numerical value “1” shall signify positive balancing direction i.e. the balancing energy reference price shall be the upward balancing energy price of the respective imbalance area, to which the neutrality component shall be added.

nodes.title: Normal activations - Total
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy bids activated from both mFRR & ER mFRR product bids for Baltic CoBA balancing purposes with the aim of minimizing the Baltic ACE. Volumes are shown based on the location of the resource.

nodes.title: Normal activations - mFRR
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy bids activated from mFRR product bids for Baltic CoBA balancing purposes with the aim of minimizing the Baltic ACE. Volumes are shown based on the location of the resource.

nodes.title: Normal activations - ER mFRR
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy bids activated from ER mFRR product bids for Baltic CoBA balancing purposes with the aim of minimizing the Baltic ACE. Volumes are shown based on the location of the resource.

nodes.title: Special activations - Total
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy bids activated from both mFRR & ER mFRR product bids for reasons other than Baltic CoBA balancing purposes (system services & countertrade). Volumes are shown based on the location of the resource.

nodes.title: System services
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy activated from both mFRR & ER mFRR product bids other purposes (system constraints, network issues) or at the request of a non-Baltic TSO. Volumes are shown based on the location of the resource.

nodes.title: Countertrade
nodes.summary: Aggregated volume of balancing energy activated from both mFRR & ER mFRR product bids for congestion managament. Volumes are shown based on the location of the resource.

nodes.title: Current balancing state (legacy)
nodes.summary: The current balancing state denotes the area control error value as it would have been be if power balancing was not performed by the TSO. The data is published in real-time for each minute with a 25 minute delay.

nodes.title: Imbalance volumes (legacy)
nodes.summary: Imbalance volumes depict the hourly area control error value as it would have been be if power balancing was not performed by the TSOs.

nodes.title: Cross-Zonal Capacities
